resources.string: Start a new scan and delete this local draft, including its original photos? Export a PDF first if you want to keep it.
Remove this page from the draft? You can undo this.
Document crop. Drag the four numbered corners to the page edges. Full image resets the crop.
Capture or import a page. Drafts stay on this device; export a PDF to keep a separate copy. Up to 50 pages per draft.
Review all four corners, then Preview result. Swipe the action row for more tools. Natural color preserves faint handwriting and stamps.
This image may be blurred. Check Preview result and retake if needed. Review the four crop corners.
PDF saved. The editable draft and original photos remain on this device.
Could not complete the operation. Check storage and image access. Limits: 50 pages, 32 MiB per image and 512 MiB per draft. Try New scan if the draft cannot reopen.
Keep the whole page visible. Tap to focus, hold steady, then capture. You can correct the corners next.
Camera permission is needed only to take photos. Enable it in app settings, or import an image from the scanner.
Could not start the camera or capture this photo. Retry, or return to import an image.

Tap Add photo to open the camera, or Import image to use an existing photo. After adding a page, adjust its corners and preview the result. Your draft stays on this device; save a PDF to keep a separate copy.
